summary.motive: Attack the deep middle with two synchronized seam-post strokes that force the single-high safety to pick a side.
summary.whyItWorks: Identical outside stems freeze both corners on the fake fades, and the TE middle-hole stretch removes any underneath help, isolating the free safety between two posts.
summary.failureMode: Corners sit on the stems instead of bailing, or the safety splits the double post with depth and takes away both throws.

beats.title: 1. The Five-Step Drop and Outside Stems
beats.text: The quarterback takes his full five-step Coryell drop while both outside receivers hammer hard outside stems, convincing soft-bailing corners that fades are coming.

beats.title: 2. The Double Stroke
beats.text: At twelve yards both receivers stroke inside off their stems simultaneously. Both corners are still leaning on the fake fades, leaving the seams open behind them.

beats.title: 3. The Middle Hole Stretch
beats.text: The TE climbs to fourteen and settles in the middle hole while the slot pressures the weak seam, forcing the free safety to defend three deep threats alone.

beats.title: 4. The Frazee Shot Delivery
beats.text: The quarterback throws the seam-post away from the safety's lever. Whichever post he chooses, the backside post runs free down the middle of the field.

relations.tell: Both outside receivers take identical vertical stems before breaking — the stroke only happens after the stems have sold pure fades.
